top_statements.Query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM queues WHERE name = $1)

SELECT q.name, q.max_depth, (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs j WHERE j.queue = q.name AND j.state = 'available'), (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs j WHERE j.queue = q.name AND j.state = 'leased'), CASE WHEN q.paused THEN 0 ELSE coalesce(( SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - min(o.run_at))::float8 FROM unnest('{1,2,3,4}'::smallint[]) AS p(priority) CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT j.run_at FROM jobs j WHERE j.queue = q.name AND j.state = 'available' AND j.priority = p.priority AND j.run_at <= now() ORDER BY j.run_at LIMIT 1) o), 0) END FROM queues q

WITH next AS ( SELECT j.id FROM jobs j JOIN queues q ON q.name = j.queue WHERE j.queue = $1 AND j.state = 'available' AND j.run_at <= now() AND NOT q.paused ORDER BY j.priority, j.run_at, j.id LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE jobs j SET state = 'leased', attempts = j.attempts + 1, lease_token = gen_random_uuid(), lease_expires_at = now() + interval '1 millisecond' * coalesce($3::bigint, (SELECT visibility_timeout_ms FROM queues WHERE name = $1)) FROM next WHERE j.id = next.id RETURNING j.id, j.queue, j.kind, j.payload, j.priority, j.state, j.run_at, j.attempts, j.max_attempts, j.last_error, j.lease_token, j.lease_expires_at, j.idempotency_key, j.trace_context, j.created_at, j.finished_at, now()
SELECT id, queue, attempts, max_attempts, coalesce(last_error, $2) FROM jobs WHERE state = $3 AND lease_expires_at < now() ORDER BY lease_expires_at LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
DELETE FROM jobs WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE state IN ($3, $4) AND finished_at < now() - interval $5 * $1::bigint LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
DELETE FROM jobs WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE state = $3 AND finished_at < now() - interval $4 * $1::bigint LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
